title: POST /api/v1/feed/signals/ batch v1
description: One telemetry batch from the web tracker (docs/intelligence/03 section 4.4). At most 50 events and 32 KB. Attribution (surface, config version, variant, source, position) is stamped by the server from the serve token `st`; a client `cfg` or `variant` is accepted and ignored, any other unknown field is refused (a batch-level one refuses the batch, an event-level one drops that event). The server answers 202 with {accepted, duplicate, rejected: {reason: n}}; a retried batch_id is a no-op. watch_ms is the cumulative watch time of one play (play_index, named on video_start).

session_id.description: Per tab; rotates after 30 min idle.

ts.description: Client time; outside +-24 h of the server it is clamped (flag ts_clamped).

st.description: The serve token the item came with.

surface.description: Hint, kept only for unattributed events and only profile, search, groups or link.

pos.description: The feed position of an impression, when the client knows it. Optional: a served item's position comes from its serve token, and a card seen off a ranked surface (profile, group, search) has none.

idef.description: feed_impression only: the impression rule the client measured with (1: >= 50% of the card for 1 s; 2: also >= 50% of the viewport covered, 08 section 7.12). The upper bound is the active Home config's delivery.impression.def_version; above it the event is dropped (invalid_idef). Absent = 1. On any other event type it is an unknown field.
